parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613769' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_relation = '=' ORDER BY cs.canonical_smiles ASC, md.chembl_id ASC, a.standard_type ASC, a.standard_relation ASC, a.standard_value ASC, a.standard_units ASC
